summary:
Fourth candidate (action=obligation) on the snapshot receive path, plus a map extension; preflight-validated with valid=True and no diagnostics.

Sourced discrepancy: after a successful InstallSnapshot the receiver adopts lastApplied and lastSnapshot from the request and compacts, but never calls setLastLog (raft.go:1928-1953; the only setLastLog callers are NewRaft, liveBootstrap, restoreUserSnapshot, dispatchLogs and appendEntries), and its compaction stops at the snapshot index (snapshot.go:213-259, maxLog = min(snapIdx, lastLogIdx-trailing)). Because the effective last entry is the maximum of log and snapshot position (state.go:157-174), a receiver that already holds a longer divergent tail keeps reporting it. A direct local run of the receive path confirmed it: with a log seeded to index 5 and a snapshot installed at index 3, compaction reported 'from=1 to=3', two entries survived, lastApplied and the snapshot index became 3, and the node's effective last entry stayed (5, term 1) so the predicate within_installed_snapshot was false.

Product contents: obligation claim-install-snapshot-alignment (implementation_semantics) — on installing a snapshot at N, a receiver that no longer holds a matching entry at N must discard entries above N so its last entry, vote comparisons and replication decisions are not based on an unconfirmed branch; one question grounded on the new principal Fact f-log-snapshot-agreement (A3), direct Behavior b-install-snapshot-align (A3), lifecycle preservation, with supporting behaviors b-stable-position-reconstruction, b-append-entries-sync and b-replication-recovery; and one physical binding (symbol installSnapshot over the contiguous raft.go:1810-1953 range).

Map extension (base version 11): new Behavior b-install-snapshot-align and Fact f-log-snapshot-agreement; no accepted object's meaning, identity or edges changed, so the three confirmed findings keep their original basis.

Retained counterevidence and unknowns, not suppressed: the retained tail may be transient because the leader's next AppendEntries starts at N+1 and truncates on term mismatch; the local observation used a single node with no leader traffic, so it shows the state rather than its duration or consequence; and whether a real leader can drive a follower into that state, and whether the window can affect a vote or election, are explicit premises for a later check. No violation is asserted yet.
